description: Default capability for the Coffer desktop window: Tauri's autogenerated `core:default` baseline and nothing more. The shell's own IPC commands — the daemon-info handshake, the restart, the version-skew check — are application commands, which the ACL does not gate, so listing them here is not a thing that can be done. Every show/hide/focus/unminimize the shell performs it performs FROM Rust (`tray.rs`, `lib.rs`), which is a direct API call rather than IPC, so a `core:window:allow-show`-style grant buys the webview a reach the shell never uses: `core:window:default` alone leaves the page able to read the window's geometry and unable to move, hide or close it. No dialog or opener permissions either — native file actions go to the daemon over HTTP in both hosts. The notification plugin is registered in `lib.rs` and deliberately granted NOTHING here: the shell raises its own sync alert from Rust (`sync_watch.rs`, spec vault-sync FR-096), which the ACL does not gate, so listing `notification:default` would only hand the page a banner the shell never asked it to raise.
